description: Frontend: Community sensor network dashboard page at /community with live map, metrics, and sensor details. Reuses existing Leaflet map component from station-map.tsx. Displays markers colored by PM2.5 level (green <30, yellow 30-60, orange 60-100, red >100, grey if offline >2 min). Polls backend every 5 seconds for live updates. Shows dashboard metrics (total/online/offline sensor counts), selected sensor details panel with latest reading, and Recharts time-series chart of PM2.5/PM10 history.
steps: 1. Add CommunitySensor and CommunitySensorReading types to /home/vishwas/Desktop/CC/community-air-quality/frontend/src/lib/types.ts matching backend schemas.

2. Create /home/vishwas/Desktop/CC/community-air-quality/frontend/src/app/community/page.tsx as client component. Fetch /api/v1/community/sensors on mount and every 5 seconds with useEffect and setInterval (return cleanup to clearInterval). State: sensors (CommunitySensor[]), selectedSensorId (string|null), loading (bool).

3. Implement dashboard metrics section at top: total sensors count, online count (last_seen within 2 minutes of now), offline count (total - online), latest readings count (sum of sensors with latest_reading not null). Use grid layout, card styling consistent with existing components.

4. Create /home/vishwas/Desktop/CC/community-air-quality/frontend/src/components/community/CommunitySensorMap.tsx following pattern from station-map.tsx. Adapt to use CommunitySensor type. Marker color logic: if latest_reading exists and last_seen within 2 min, color by PM2.5 (green <30, yellow 30-60, orange 60-100, red >100); else grey (offline). Popup shows sensor name, location, PM2.5, PM10, temp, humidity, last_seen timestamp, status. OnClick sets selectedSensorId.

5. Create /home/vishwas/Desktop/CC/community-air-quality/frontend/src/components/community/SensorDetails.tsx: displays selected sensor info (name, ID, coordinates, status, last_seen), latest reading (PM2.5, PM10, temp, humidity, recorded_at) in card format, button to fetch history.

6. Create /home/vishwas/Desktop/CC/community-air-quality/frontend/src/components/community/SensorHistory.tsx: on load or when selected sensor changes, fetch GET /api/v1/community/sensors/{sensor_id}/readings?limit=50. Display Recharts LineChart with two lines: PM2.5 (blue) and PM10 (orange), x-axis recorded_at (formatted time), y-axis concentration. Handle loading/error states. If no sensor selected, show placeholder.

7. Layout page.tsx: header 'Community Sensor Network', metrics dashboard, map (left 60%), details + history panel (right 40% when sensor selected, else show 'Select a sensor on the map'). Use Tailwind grid/flex layout consistent with existing pages.
8. Add navigation link to /community in /home/vishwas/Desktop/CC/community-air-quality/frontend/src/components/site-header.tsx if not already present.

9. Test responsive layout and live updates: open page, verify map shows 10 sensors, verify metrics update every 5s, verify selecting sensor shows details, verify chart displays historical data, verify color changes when simulator runs spike scenario.
acceptance_criteria: Frontend builds without errors: npm run build succeeds
Page /community renders with map showing 10 sensor markers
Markers colored correctly by PM2.5 level (green/yellow/orange/red/grey)
Dashboard metrics display total, online, offline counts accurately
Clicking marker selects sensor and displays details panel
Details panel shows latest reading values and last_seen timestamp
History chart displays PM2.5 and PM10 lines with x-axis as time
Page polls backend every 5 seconds and updates metrics/map/details
Offline sensors (last_seen >2 min ago) shown as grey markers
When simulator runs, updates appear within 5 seconds on frontend
verification: cd /home/vishwas/Desktop/CC/community-air-quality/frontend && npm run build (verify no TypeScript or build errors)
cd /home/vishwas/Desktop/CC/community-air-quality/frontend && npm run dev (start dev server)
Open http://localhost:3000/community in browser, verify 10 markers appear on map
With simulator running in background, observe metrics update every 5 seconds
Click a marker, verify details panel appears with sensor info
Verify chart shows historical readings with two lines (PM2.5, PM10)
Stop simulator for one sensor, wait 2+ minutes, verify that sensor's marker turns grey
Trigger spike in simulator, verify affected sensor's marker color changes within 5-10 seconds
